claims.quote: GRIN2B (encoding glutamate ionotropic NMDA receptor subunit 2B)

claims.object_text: location across the surface of dendrites
claims.quote: brain somatic mutations in GRIN2B (encoding glutamate ionotropic NMDA receptor subunit 2B), which were found in two patients with SCZ, disrupted the location of GRIN2B across the surface of dendrites among primary cultured neurons.
